name: munchkin-lan
description: A mobile-first LAN multiplayer card game foundation.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @munchkin-lan/web && npm run build --workspace @munchkin-lan/server
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @munchkin-lan/contracts && npm run build --workspace @munchkin-lan/game-engine
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.ui:prepare: npm run build:packages && npm run ui:typecheck
scripts.ui:test: npm run ui:prepare && npm run ui:clean -- test && playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.ui:audit: npm run ui:prepare && npm run ui:clean -- audit && playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts --grep @audit
scripts.ui:map: npm run ui:prepare && npm run ui:clean -- map && playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts --grep @map
scripts.ui:visual: npm run ui:prepare && npm run ui:clean -- visual && playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts --grep @visual
scripts.ui:update: npm run ui:prepare && npm run ui:clean -- visual && playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts --grep @visual --update-snapshots
